exercises.title: Câu phức — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: ____ online learning is flexible, it requires a high level of self-discipline.
items.explanation: Hai vế đối lập và sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề (S + V) → Although. "Despite" chỉ đi với danh từ / V-ing.

items.prompt: ____ the high cost of living, many young people still move to big cities.
items.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ "the high cost of living" → Despite. Although / Even though cần một mệnh đề.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: Although cars are convenient, but they cause pollution.
Although cars are convenient, they cause pollution.
Despite cars are convenient, they cause pollution.
Because cars are convenient, so they cause pollution.

items.explanation: Không dùng "Although … but" hay "Because … so" trong cùng một câu; "Despite" không đi với mệnh đề.

items.prompt: Governments should invest in public transport ____ people have an alternative to private cars.
items.explanation: "so that" + mệnh đề chỉ mục đích: để người dân có lựa chọn khác ngoài xe riêng.

items.prompt: Air pollution will continue to worsen ____ stricter regulations are introduced.
items.explanation: "unless" = if … not: ô nhiễm sẽ tệ hơn NẾU KHÔNG có quy định chặt hơn.

exercises.title: Câu phức — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Complex Sentences — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Điền liên từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (dùng các từ trong khung).

items.prompt: ____ many people prefer living in cities, rural areas offer a slower pace of life.
items.explanation: Hai ý đối lập, mệnh đề phụ đứng đầu → Although (+ dấu phẩy).

items.prompt: Many students choose to study abroad ____ foreign degrees are highly valued by employers.
items.explanation: Vế sau là lý do → because.

items.prompt: Endangered species will disappear ____ urgent action is taken.
items.explanation: "unless" = if … not: sẽ biến mất nếu KHÔNG hành động.

items.prompt: Parents should limit screen time ____ children can develop better social skills.
items.explanation: Mục đích + mệnh đề có modal (can) → so that.

items.prompt: Some people work best in the morning, ____ others are more productive at night.
items.explanation: So sánh đối lập hai nhóm người → whereas / while.

exercises.title: Câu phức — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: Online courses are cheap. However, they lack face-to-face interaction.
sampleAnswers: Although online courses are cheap, they lack face-to-face interaction.
items.explanation: Gộp hai câu đối lập thành câu phức: Although + mệnh đề phụ, mệnh đề chính — bỏ "However".

items.prompt: Although the tuition fees are high, many students apply to this university.
sampleAnswers: Despite the high tuition fees, many students apply to this university.
items.explanation: "Despite" + cụm danh từ: "the tuition fees are high" → "the high tuition fees".

items.prompt: Rural areas offer few job opportunities, so young people move to cities.
sampleAnswers: Because rural areas offer few job opportunities, young people move to cities.
items.explanation: Đưa lý do lên đầu với Because và bỏ "so" — không dùng Because … so.

items.prompt: If people do not recycle more, landfill sites will run out of space.
sampleAnswers: Unless people recycle more, landfill sites will run out of space.
items.explanation: "Unless" đã mang nghĩa phủ định → bỏ "do not".

items.prompt: Schools should teach cooking. Then children can eat more healthily.
sampleAnswers: Schools should teach cooking so that children can eat more healthily.
items.explanation: "so that" nối mệnh đề chỉ mục đích, mệnh đề phụ đứng sau nên không cần dấu phẩy.

exercises.title: Câu ghép — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG dấu câu:

options.text: Technology is convenient, it saves time.
Technology is convenient, and it saves time.
Technology is convenient and, it saves time.
Technology is convenient however it saves time.

items.explanation: Hai mệnh đề độc lập nối bằng ", and". Câu A là comma splice (chỉ có dấu phẩy trơn).

items.prompt: Public transport is cheap; ____, it is often overcrowded.
items.explanation: Hai ý đối lập (rẻ ↔ đông đúc), cấu trúc "; ___," → however.

items.prompt: Fast food is cheap and convenient, ____ it is often high in fat and sugar.
items.explanation: Đối lập (tiện ↔ không tốt cho sức khoẻ) → ", but".

items.prompt: Many factories have moved overseas; ____, unemployment has risen in some regions.
items.explanation: Vế sau là KẾT QUẢ của vế trước → therefore.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: It is cheap, however it is slow.
It is cheap; however, it is slow.
It is cheap; however it, is slow.
It is cheap however, it is slow.

items.explanation: "However" không phải liên từ: dùng "; however," hoặc tách thành hai câu.

exercises.title: Câu ghép — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Compound Sentences — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Điền từ nối phù hợp vào chỗ trống (dùng các từ trong khung).

items.prompt: Cycling is good for health, ____ it also reduces air pollution.
items.explanation: Bổ sung thêm một lợi ích → and (đã có "also").

items.prompt: The government lowered taxes, ____ the economy did not recover.
items.explanation: Kết quả trái mong đợi → but / yet.

items.prompt: Housing in cities is expensive, ____ many young people still live with their parents.
items.explanation: Vế sau là kết quả → so.

items.prompt: Renewable energy is clean; ____, it can be expensive to install.
items.explanation: Đối lập, đứng sau dấu chấm phẩy và trước dấu phẩy → however.

items.prompt: Traffic congestion wastes time; ____, cities should invest in public transport.
items.explanation: Nêu kết luận / kết quả, dạng "; ___," → therefore.

exercises.title: Câu ghép — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: Online shopping is convenient. It can lead to overspending.
sampleAnswers: Online shopping is convenient, but it can lead to overspending.
items.explanation: Hai ý đối lập → ", but" giữa hai mệnh đề độc lập.

items.prompt: Many people work from home. They save time on commuting.
sampleAnswers: Many people work from home, so they save time on commuting.
items.explanation: Vế sau là kết quả → ", so".

items.prompt: Smartphones are useful. They can be addictive.
sampleAnswers: Smartphones are useful; however, they can be addictive.
items.explanation: Mẫu "; however," — chấm phẩy trước, phẩy sau.

items.prompt: The population is ageing. Healthcare costs are rising.
sampleAnswers: The population is ageing; therefore, healthcare costs are rising.
items.explanation: Nguyên nhân → kết quả: "; therefore,".

items.prompt: Exercise improves mood, it also reduces stress.
sampleAnswers: Exercise improves mood, and it also reduces stress.
items.explanation: Câu gốc là comma splice → thêm liên từ "and" sau dấu phẩy.

exercises.title: Câu điều kiện — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: If governments ____ more in renewable energy, carbon emissions will fall.
items.explanation: Loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, … will + V. Không dùng "will" trong mệnh đề If.

items.prompt: If cities ____ more green spaces, residents would be healthier.
items.explanation: Loại 2 (giả định hiện tại): If + quá khứ đơn, … would + V.

items.prompt: If the government had acted earlier, the crisis ____.
items.explanation: Loại 3: If + had V3, … would have + V3 (ở đây bị động: would have been avoided).

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: Unless governments don't act, pollution will worsen.
Unless governments act, pollution will worsen.
Unless governments will act, pollution worsens.
If governments act not, pollution will worsen.

items.explanation: "Unless" đã mang nghĩa phủ định → không thêm "don't"; không dùng "will" sau Unless.

items.prompt: Students can borrow laptops ____ they return them within a week.
items.explanation: "provided that" = miễn là (điều kiện).

exercises.title: Câu điều kiện — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Conditional Sentences — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Chia động từ trong ngoặc cho đúng loại câu điều kiện.

items.prompt: If people ____ (use) public transport more often, traffic congestion will decrease.
items.explanation: Loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn.

items.prompt: If I ____ (be) the mayor, I would build more cycle lanes.
items.explanation: Loại 2 với "be": văn trang trọng dùng "were" cho mọi ngôi.

items.prompt: If the factory had followed safety rules, the accident ____ (not happen).
items.explanation: Loại 3: would not have + V3.

items.prompt: Unless the government ____ (raise) taxes, it cannot fund new hospitals.
items.explanation: Sau Unless dùng hiện tại đơn; chủ ngữ số ít → raises.

items.prompt: If young people ____ (have) more job opportunities at home, fewer of them would move abroad.
items.explanation: Loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, … would + V.

exercises.title: Câu điều kiện — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: If students do not revise regularly, they will forget what they have learned.
sampleAnswers: Unless students revise regularly, they will forget what they have learned.
items.explanation: Unless = if … not → bỏ "do not".

items.prompt: People do not exercise enough, so they suffer from health problems.
sampleAnswers: If people exercised enough, they would not suffer from health problems.
items.explanation: Giả định trái thực tế hiện tại → loại 2, đảo cả hai vế sang nghĩa ngược lại.

items.prompt: The government did not invest in flood defences, so the town was badly damaged.
sampleAnswers: If the government had invested in flood defences, the town would not have been badly damaged.
items.explanation: Giả định trái thực tế quá khứ → loại 3: If + had V3, … would not have + V3.

items.prompt: Working from home is effective only if employees are self-disciplined.
sampleAnswers: Working from home is effective provided that employees are self-disciplined.
items.explanation: "only if" ≈ "provided that" (miễn là).

items.prompt: If this trend is left unchecked, it will damage the environment.
sampleAnswers: If left unchecked, this trend will damage the environment.
items.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề If bị động: If + V3. Chủ ngữ "this trend" chuyển sang mệnh đề chính.

exercises.title: Câu bị động — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: More hospitals should ____ in rural areas.
items.explanation: Bị động với modal: should + be + V3.

items.prompt: It is widely ____ that education is the key to reducing poverty.
items.explanation: Mẫu khách quan: It is widely believed that …

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: The accident was happened last night.
The accident was happen last night.
The accident has been happened last night.

items.explanation: "happen" là nội động từ (không có tân ngữ) → không chia bị động.

items.prompt: Many measures ____ to reduce air pollution in recent years.
items.explanation: "in recent years" → hiện tại hoàn thành; chủ ngữ số nhiều + bị động → have been taken.

items.prompt: Smoking ____ in public places in many countries.
items.explanation: Hút thuốc BỊ cấm → bị động hiện tại đơn: is banned.

exercises.title: Câu bị động — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Passive Voice — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở dạng bị động, đúng thì.

items.prompt: Millions of plastic bottles ____ (throw) away every day.
items.explanation: Hiện tại đơn bị động, chủ ngữ số nhiều → are thrown.

items.prompt: New laws ____ (introduce) last year to protect wildlife.
items.explanation: "last year" → quá khứ đơn bị động: were introduced.

items.prompt: Funding for the arts ____ (cut) significantly since 2020.
items.explanation: "since 2020" → hiện tại hoàn thành; chủ ngữ "funding" số ít → has been cut.

items.prompt: Stricter rules should ____ (enforce) on social media companies.
items.explanation: should + be + V3.

items.prompt: Online learning ____ (think) to be less effective for young children.
items.explanation: Mẫu S + is thought + to V.

exercises.title: Câu bị động — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: People cut down millions of trees every year.
sampleAnswers: Millions of trees are cut down every year.
items.explanation: Tân ngữ lên làm chủ ngữ; bỏ "by people" vì tác nhân chung chung.

items.prompt: Governments have built many new roads in recent years.
sampleAnswers: Many new roads have been built in recent years.
items.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành bị động: have been + V3; bỏ tác nhân hiển nhiên.

items.prompt: People widely believe that money cannot buy happiness.
sampleAnswers: It is widely believed that money cannot buy happiness.
items.explanation: Mẫu khách quan: It is widely believed that + mệnh đề.

items.prompt: People think that social media is harmful to teenagers.
sampleAnswers: Social media is thought to be harmful to teenagers.
items.explanation: S + is thought + to V: chủ ngữ của mệnh đề "that" lên đầu câu.

items.prompt: Companies should give employees more flexible working hours.
sampleAnswers: Employees should be given more flexible working hours.
items.explanation: should + be + V3; tân ngữ người (employees) lên làm chủ ngữ.

exercises.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: Students ____ study abroad often become more independent.
items.explanation: Thay cho người, làm chủ ngữ → who.

items.prompt: Many people work from home, ____ reduces traffic congestion.
items.explanation: Bổ sung ý cho cả mệnh đề trước, sau dấu phẩy → ", which". Không dùng "that" sau dấu phẩy.

items.prompt: Children ____ parents read to them develop better language skills.
items.explanation: Sở hữu (cha mẹ CỦA trẻ) → whose + danh từ.

items.prompt: Rural areas are places ____ public services are often limited.
items.explanation: Nơi chốn, sau đó là một mệnh đề đầy đủ → where.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: The students who they study abroad gain confidence.
Governments should support policies which helps the poor.
Governments should support policies which help the poor.
Many people cycle to work, that improves their health.

items.explanation: "policies" số nhiều → help. A lặp chủ ngữ "they"; D dùng "that" sau dấu phẩy.

exercises.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Relative Clauses — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Điền đại từ / trạng từ quan hệ phù hợp (dùng các từ trong khung).

items.prompt: Teachers ____ use technology effectively can make lessons more engaging.
items.explanation: Thay cho người, làm chủ ngữ → who.

items.prompt: Many cities have introduced congestion charges, ____ has reduced traffic.
items.explanation: Bổ sung ý cho cả mệnh đề trước, sau dấu phẩy → which.

items.prompt: Employees ____ salaries are low may look for a second job.
items.explanation: Lương CỦA nhân viên → whose.

items.prompt: Libraries are places ____ people can study for free.
items.explanation: Nơi chốn + mệnh đề đầy đủ → where.

items.prompt: The 1990s was a decade ____ the internet changed everyday life.
items.explanation: Thời gian → when.

exercises.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: The government raised taxes on cigarettes. This reduced smoking rates.
items.starter: The government raised taxes on cigarettes,
sampleAnswers: The government raised taxes on cigarettes, which reduced smoking rates.
items.explanation: ", which" thay cho "This" để mở rộng ý cả mệnh đề trước — mẹo nâng band nhanh nhất.

items.prompt: Some young people use social media too much. They often sleep badly.
sampleAnswers: Young people who use social media too much often sleep badly.
items.explanation: Mệnh đề xác định với who (không dấu phẩy) thay cho "They".

items.prompt: Some parents work long hours. Their children often spend time alone.
sampleAnswers: Children whose parents work long hours often spend time alone.
items.explanation: "Their children" → whose: sở hữu.

items.prompt: People who live in cities often suffer from stress.
sampleAnswers: People living in cities often suffer from stress.
items.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: who live → living.

items.prompt: Products which are made in factories are usually cheaper.
sampleAnswers: Products made in factories are usually cheaper.
items.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: which are made → made.

exercises.title: Đảo ngữ — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: Not only ____ costs, but it also improves efficiency.
items.explanation: "Not only" đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ: does it + V nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: Never before ____ so much information available to ordinary people.
items.explanation: Never before + have/has + S + V3.

items.prompt: Only by investing in education ____ poverty.
items.explanation: Only by + V-ing + trợ động từ + S + V nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: Rarely ____ politicians admit their mistakes.
items.explanation: Rarely + trợ động từ + S + V; chủ ngữ số nhiều, hiện tại đơn → do.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: This approach not only reduces costs but also improves efficiency.
This approach not only does reduce costs but also improves efficiency.
Not only this approach reduces costs but also improves efficiency.
Not only does this approach reduces costs, but it also improves efficiency.

items.explanation: "not only" giữa câu thì KHÔNG đảo (A). C thiếu đảo ngữ; D sai "reduces" sau "does".

exercises.title: Đảo ngữ — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Inversion for Emphasis — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Điền trợ động từ phù hợp cho câu đảo ngữ (dùng các từ trong khung).

items.prompt: Not only ____ exercise improve physical health, but it also reduces stress.
items.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít, hiện tại đơn → does + V nguyên mẫu (improve).

items.prompt: Never before ____ people relied so heavily on technology.
items.explanation: Never before + have + S + V3 (relied).

items.prompt: Seldom ____ young people read printed newspapers nowadays.
items.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều, hiện tại đơn → do.

items.prompt: Only by working together ____ countries tackle climate change.
items.explanation: Only by + V-ing + can + S + V.

items.prompt: Under no circumstances ____ children be left alone near water.
items.explanation: Under no circumstances + should + S + V (khuyến nghị mạnh).

exercises.title: Đảo ngữ — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.titleEn: Inversion for Emphasis — Rewrite, same meaning
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: Public transport reduces traffic, and it also cuts pollution.
sampleAnswers: Not only does public transport reduce traffic, but it also cuts pollution.
items.explanation: Not only + does + S + V nguyên mẫu, but + S + also + V.

items.prompt: People have never had so much access to information before.
sampleAnswers: Never before have people had so much access to information.
items.explanation: Never before + have + S + V3.

items.prompt: We can only solve this problem by cooperating internationally.
sampleAnswers: Only by cooperating internationally can we solve this problem.
items.explanation: Only by + V-ing + can + S + V.

items.prompt: Students rarely have time to relax before exams.
sampleAnswers: Rarely do students have time to relax before exams.
items.explanation: Rarely đầu câu → đảo "do" + S + V nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: Employees should not share passwords under any circumstances.
sampleAnswers: Under no circumstances should employees share passwords.
items.explanation: Under no circumstances + should + S + V; bỏ "not" vì cụm đã mang nghĩa phủ định.

exercises.title: Câu chẻ — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: It is technology ____ has changed the way we communicate.
items.explanation: It is + thành phần nhấn mạnh (vật) + that + phần còn lại.

items.prompt: What students need most ____ practical experience.
items.explanation: Động từ sau mệnh đề "What …" chia số ít → is.

items.prompt: It was my grandmother ____ taught me to cook.
items.explanation: Nhấn mạnh người → who.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: It is technology that it changes our lives.
It is technology that changes our lives.
It is technology what changes our lives.
It technology is that changes our lives.

items.explanation: Không thêm chủ ngữ thừa "it" sau "that"; không dùng "what" trong mẫu It is … that.

items.prompt: Câu nào KHÔNG phải câu chẻ?

options.text: It is important that children learn to swim.
It is the government that should fund research.
What worries me is the rising cost of housing.
It was in 2010 that the law was passed.

items.explanation: "It is + adj + that" là câu bình thường, không nhấn mạnh thành phần nào.

exercises.title: Câu chẻ — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Cleft Sentences — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Điền từ còn thiếu để hoàn thành câu chẻ (dùng các từ trong khung).

items.prompt: It is parents ____ have the greatest influence on children.
items.explanation: Nhấn mạnh người → who.

items.prompt: ____ concerns many people is the rising cost of living.
items.explanation: Mẫu What + V + is + thành phần nhấn mạnh.

items.prompt: It was in 2015 ____ the new law came into force.
items.explanation: Nhấn mạnh thời gian → that.

items.prompt: What young people need ____ more job opportunities.
items.explanation: Sau mệnh đề "What …" động từ chia số ít.

items.prompt: The main reason ____ people move to cities is that they want better jobs.
items.explanation: The main reason why … is that …

exercises.title: Câu chẻ — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: Parents play the most important role in a child's education.
sampleAnswers: It is parents who play the most important role in a child's education.
items.explanation: Nhấn mạnh người (parents) → It is … who.

items.prompt: Many workers want more flexible hours.
sampleAnswers: What many workers want is more flexible hours.
items.explanation: What + S + V + is + thành phần nhấn mạnh.

items.prompt: Governments should take responsibility for protecting the environment.
sampleAnswers: It is governments that should take responsibility for protecting the environment.
items.explanation: Nhấn mạnh chủ thể: It is + N + that + phần còn lại (không thêm chủ ngữ).

items.prompt: The lack of affordable housing worries young people most.
sampleAnswers: What worries young people most is the lack of affordable housing.
items.explanation: Đưa thông tin cần nhấn mạnh xuống cuối sau "is".

items.prompt: People move to cities mainly because they want better jobs.
sampleAnswers: The main reason why people move to cities is that they want better jobs.
items.explanation: The main reason why … is that … (không viết "is because").

exercises.title: Cấu trúc song song — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: Regular exercise helps people to lose weight, reduce stress and ____ their sleep.
items.explanation: Liệt kê ba động từ nguyên mẫu: lose, reduce, improve.

items.prompt: The new policy is not only cheap but also ____.
items.explanation: Hai vế của not only … but also cùng loại từ: cheap (adj) — time-saving (adj).

items.prompt: Students can either study online ____ attend classes on campus.
items.explanation: either … or.

items.prompt: Neither the government nor individuals ____ doing enough to reduce waste.
items.explanation: Với neither … nor, động từ chia theo danh từ gần nhất (individuals → are).

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: Technology helps to reduce costs, improving productivity, and better service.
Technology helps to reduce costs, improve productivity and enhance customer service.
Technology helps reducing costs, to improve productivity and better service.
Technology helps to reduce costs, improves productivity and enhancing service.

items.explanation: Ba vế cùng dạng (to) V: reduce — improve — enhance.

exercises.title: Cấu trúc song song — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Parallel Structures — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Viết dạng đúng của từ trong ngoặc để các vế song song.

items.prompt: Living in the countryside means breathing clean air, eating fresh food and ____ (enjoy) a slower pace of life.
items.explanation: Ba vế V-ing: breathing — eating — enjoying.

items.prompt: Governments should invest in schools, train more teachers and ____ (raise) teachers' salaries.
items.explanation: Ba vế V nguyên mẫu sau should: invest — train — raise.

items.prompt: Online learning is both flexible and ____ (afford).
items.explanation: both A and B cùng loại từ: flexible (adj) — affordable (adj).

items.prompt: Many people prefer cycling rather than ____ (drive) to work.
items.explanation: rather than: hai vế cùng dạng V-ing (cycling — driving).

items.prompt: Neither the teacher nor the students ____ (be) happy with the new timetable.
items.explanation: Động từ chia theo danh từ gần nhất "the students" (số nhiều).

exercises.title: Cấu trúc song song — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: Online shopping saves time. It also saves money.
sampleAnswers: Online shopping saves both time and money.
items.explanation: both A and B: hai danh từ song song.

items.prompt: Smartphones are useful for communication. They are also useful for learning.
sampleAnswers: Smartphones are useful not only for communication but also for learning.
items.explanation: Hai vế cùng dạng "for + N".

items.prompt: The course teaches students to write, reading and speak English.
items.starter: The course teaches students to write,
sampleAnswers: The course teaches students to write, read and speak English.
items.explanation: "reading" lệch dạng → đổi thành "read" cho cùng dạng V nguyên mẫu.

items.prompt: Governments can raise taxes on cars, or they can improve public transport.
sampleAnswers: Governments can either raise taxes on cars or improve public transport.
items.explanation: either + V … or + V: hai động từ song song.

items.prompt: The government is not doing enough to reduce waste, and individuals are not doing enough either.
sampleAnswers: Neither the government nor individuals are doing enough to reduce waste.
items.explanation: Động từ chia theo danh từ gần nhất (individuals → are).

exercises.title: Động từ khuyết thiếu — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: Governments should ____ more in public healthcare.
items.explanation: Sau modal là V nguyên mẫu không "to".

items.prompt: This technology ____ harm young people's mental health if it is overused.
items.explanation: Dự đoán thận trọng → could + V. Không chia modal, không dùng hai modal liền nhau.

items.prompt: Stricter laws must ____ to protect endangered animals.
items.explanation: Luật ĐƯỢC ban hành → bị động: must + be + V3.

items.prompt: Chọn câu thận trọng, mang tính học thuật nhất:

options.text: Social media will definitely destroy society.
Social media could seriously harm society.
Social media destroys society for sure.

items.explanation: Tránh tuyệt đối hoá; dùng could để dự đoán thận trọng.

items.prompt: In the future, robots ____ do many household tasks.
items.explanation: Không dùng "will can" → will be able to + V.

exercises.title: Động từ khuyết thiếu — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Modal Verbs — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Điền từ phù hợp vào chỗ trống (dùng các từ trong khung).

items.prompt: Schools ____ teach students how to manage money.
items.explanation: Đề xuất → should.

items.prompt: Working from home ____ reduce productivity for some employees.
items.explanation: Khả năng, dự đoán thận trọng → might / may / could.

items.prompt: More cycle lanes should ____ built in city centres.
items.explanation: Bị động với modal: should + be + V3.

items.prompt: The government should ____ acted earlier to prevent the crisis.
items.explanation: Tiếc nuối về quá khứ: should have + V3.

items.prompt: In the future, people will be ____ to work from anywhere.
items.explanation: will be able to + V (thay cho "will can").

exercises.title: Động từ khuyết thiếu — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: It is necessary for governments to invest in renewable energy.
sampleAnswers: Governments must invest in renewable energy.
items.explanation: "It is necessary for … to V" = S + must + V.

items.prompt: It is possible that online learning will replace some traditional classes.
sampleAnswers: Online learning may replace some traditional classes.
items.explanation: "It is possible that …" = S + may + V.

items.prompt: It is a good idea for parents to limit their children's screen time.
sampleAnswers: Parents should limit their children's screen time.
items.explanation: Lời khuyên → should + V.

items.prompt: Supermarkets should stop giving out plastic bags.
sampleAnswers: Plastic bags should not be given out by supermarkets.
items.explanation: should + not + be + V3; tác nhân cụ thể (supermarkets) nên giữ "by".

items.prompt: It was a mistake that the city did not build more schools.
sampleAnswers: The city should have built more schools.
items.explanation: Chỉ trích / tiếc nuối việc trong quá khứ → should have + V3.

exercises.title: Cấu trúc so sánh — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: Living in a big city is ____ more expensive than living in the countryside.
items.explanation: Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn dùng far / much / significantly — không dùng "very".

items.prompt: The more people use public transport, ____ the roads become.
items.explanation: The + so sánh hơn …, the + so sánh hơn …

items.prompt: Air pollution is one of the most serious ____ in big cities.
items.explanation: one of the + so sánh nhất + danh từ SỐ NHIỀU.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: Electric cars are more cheaper to run than petrol cars.
Electric cars are much cheaper to run than petrol cars.
Electric cars are very cheaper to run than petrol cars.
Electric cars are the most cheapest to run.

items.explanation: Không dùng so sánh kép (more cheaper, most cheapest); nhấn mạnh bằng much.

items.prompt: The cost of living in cities is higher than ____ in rural areas.
items.explanation: So sánh đúng đối tượng: "that" thay cho "the cost of living" (số ít).

exercises.title: Cấu trúc so sánh — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Comparatives and Superlatives — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Viết dạng so sánh đúng của từ trong ngoặc (có thể cần thêm the / as).

items.prompt: Online courses are often ____ (cheap) than traditional courses.
items.explanation: Tính từ ngắn → adj-er + than.

items.prompt: This is ____ (effective) way to reduce traffic congestion.
items.explanation: So sánh nhất tính từ dài → the most + adj.

items.prompt: The ____ (old) people get, the more they value their health.
items.explanation: The + so sánh hơn …, the + so sánh hơn …

items.prompt: Houses in the capital are three times ____ (expensive) as those in rural areas.
items.explanation: Gấp nhiều lần: three times as + adj + as.

items.prompt: Prices in the capital are significantly ____ (high) than in other cities.
items.explanation: significantly + so sánh hơn.

exercises.title: Cấu trúc so sánh — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.titleEn: Comparatives and Superlatives — Rewrite, same meaning
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: Cars are less safe than trains.
sampleAnswers: Cars are not as safe as trains.
items.explanation: less + adj + than = not as + adj + as.

items.prompt: When people earn more, they spend more.
sampleAnswers: The more people earn, the more they spend.
items.explanation: Càng … càng …: The more + S + V, the more + S + V.

items.prompt: No problem in cities is more serious than traffic congestion.
sampleAnswers: Traffic congestion is the most serious problem in cities.
items.explanation: "Không gì … hơn X" = X là … nhất.

items.prompt: Houses in London cost twice the price of houses in Manchester.
sampleAnswers: Houses in London are twice as expensive as those in Manchester.
items.explanation: twice as + adj + as; "those" thay cho "houses" để so sánh đúng đối tượng.

items.prompt: Shopping in stores is far less convenient than online shopping.
sampleAnswers: Online shopping is far more convenient than shopping in stores.
items.explanation: Đảo hai vế: far less … → far more …

exercises.title: Cụm phân từ — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: The government lowered taxes, ____ more businesses to open.
items.explanation: Kết quả cho phép: …, allowing + O + to V.

items.prompt: Many people now work remotely, thereby ____ traffic congestion.
items.explanation: "thereby" + V-ing.

items.prompt: ____ properly, technology can improve students' learning.
items.explanation: Công nghệ ĐƯỢC sử dụng → bị động: V3 (Used).

items.prompt: ____ graduated, she found a job at a bank.
items.explanation: Hành động xảy ra trước: Having + V3.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: Having finished university, jobs are hard to find.
Having finished university, many graduates find it hard to get a job.
Finished university, many graduates find it hard to get a job.
Having finish university, many graduates find it hard to get a job.

items.explanation: Chủ ngữ ngầm của cụm phân từ phải trùng chủ ngữ mệnh đề chính (graduates). A là lỗi chủ ngữ treo.

exercises.title: Cụm phân từ — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Participle Clauses — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Viết dạng phân từ đúng của động từ trong ngoặc (V-ing / V3 / Having V3).

items.prompt: Cities are building more cycle lanes, thereby ____ (encourage) people to leave their cars at home.
items.explanation: thereby + V-ing.

items.prompt: Online banking is available 24/7, ____ (allow) customers to manage their money at any time.
items.explanation: Kết quả cho phép: allowing + O + to V.

items.prompt: ____ (leave) unchecked, climate change will cause serious damage.
items.explanation: Biến đổi khí hậu BỊ bỏ mặc → V3: Left.

items.prompt: ____ (complete) the course, students receive a certificate.
items.explanation: Hoàn thành khoá học TRƯỚC khi nhận chứng chỉ → Having + V3.

items.prompt: ____ (live) far from the city, many villagers rarely see a doctor.
items.explanation: Chủ động, nêu lý do → V-ing.

exercises.title: Cụm phân từ — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: Many companies let staff work from home, and this reduces office costs.
items.starter: Many companies let staff work from home, thereby
sampleAnswers: Many companies let staff work from home, thereby reducing office costs.
items.explanation: ", and this + V" → ", thereby + V-ing".

items.prompt: The government built new metro lines. This enabled commuters to travel faster.
items.starter: The government built new metro lines,
sampleAnswers: The government built new metro lines, enabling commuters to travel faster.
items.explanation: Kết quả cho phép: …, enabling + O + to V.

items.prompt: After she had finished her degree, she started her own business.
sampleAnswers: Having finished her degree, she started her own business.
items.explanation: Hai vế cùng chủ ngữ, hành động xảy ra trước → Having + V3.

items.prompt: Because they live in remote areas, many children cannot access good schools.
sampleAnswers: Living in remote areas, many children cannot access good schools.
items.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề lý do chủ động → V-ing (chủ ngữ trùng: children).

items.prompt: If it is used wisely, social media can be a powerful learning tool.
sampleAnswers: Used wisely, social media can be a powerful learning tool.
items.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề bị động → V3 (chủ ngữ trùng: social media).

exercises.title: Cách dùng thì — Trắc nghiệm
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: In recent years, the number of people working from home ____ dramatically.
items.explanation: "In recent years" → hiện tại hoàn thành; chủ ngữ "the number" số ít → has increased.

items.prompt: The government ____ a new tax on sugary drinks in 2018.
items.explanation: Mốc quá khứ cụ thể (in 2018) → quá khứ đơn.

items.prompt: Regular exercise ____ stress.
items.explanation: Sự thật chung → hiện tại đơn; chủ ngữ số ít thêm -s. Tránh tiếp diễn.

items.prompt: If current trends continue, more people ____ in cities by 2050.
items.explanation: Dự đoán tương lai → will + V.

items.prompt: Chọn câu ĐÚNG:

options.text: The law has been introduced in 2020.

items.explanation: Có "in 2020" → quá khứ đơn; luật ĐƯỢC ban hành → bị động: was introduced.

exercises.title: Cách dùng thì — Điền chỗ trống
exercises.titleEn: Tense Usage — Fill in the gaps
exercises.instruction: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở thì phù hợp.

items.prompt: Everyone ____ (need) access to clean water.
items.explanation: Sự thật chung; "everyone" số ít → needs.

items.prompt: Over the past decade, online shopping ____ (become) extremely popular.
items.explanation: "Over the past decade" → hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.prompt: Ten years ago, very few people ____ (own) a smartphone.
items.explanation: "ago" → quá khứ đơn.

items.prompt: Experts predict that robots ____ (replace) many jobs in the future.
items.explanation: Dự đoán tương lai → will + V.

items.prompt: Since 2010, the city ____ (build) more than fifty new schools.
items.explanation: "Since 2010" → hiện tại hoàn thành.

exercises.title: Cách dùng thì — Viết lại câu giữ nguyên nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi: dùng cấu trúc gợi ý trong ngoặc và bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

items.prompt: People started using smartphones widely about fifteen years ago.
sampleAnswers: People have used smartphones widely for about fifteen years.
items.explanation: Hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ, còn tiếp diễn → hiện tại hoàn thành + for.

items.prompt: The last time the city built a new hospital was in 2005.
sampleAnswers: The city has not built a new hospital since 2005.
items.explanation: "The last time … was in X" = S + has not + V3 + since X.

items.prompt: It is ten years since the government raised the minimum wage.
sampleAnswers: The government has not raised the minimum wage for ten years.
items.explanation: "It is … since" = has not + V3 + for + khoảng thời gian.

items.prompt: Last year, the government has introduced a new law.
sampleAnswers: Last year, the government introduced a new law.
items.explanation: Mốc quá khứ cụ thể (last year) → quá khứ đơn, không dùng hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.prompt: Experts expect a rise in sea levels in the coming decades.
sampleAnswers: Experts predict that sea levels will rise in the coming decades.
items.explanation: Dự đoán tương lai → will + V.
